Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. - a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **6** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 13136f73b727290d9549bf9dd574fc0587715388` → `packageMentionDocs`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0570b5e6e58b4accce82bd6cf6d1c948a78a7e06`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/index.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/render-export-retired.pin.test.ts + packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/package.json (`exports`, `files`), packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts (`IEmailService`), packages/services/service-messaging/src/index.ts (`interpolate`), tsup.config.ts (entry)

Face: narrowing (`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` line-initial on the PR body and on `.changeset/25190-retire-render-template-export.md`; no schema and no governed path in the diff). Inputs read: card #25190 body and all 11 comments (rulings `6335348115` on #25082, `6349343463`, `6349391984`, `6351169534`, the spec-lane notes `6350996010` / `6356337552`, the ops reading `6392298822`, the claim `6430890446` and the dev report `6431921813`); PR #26399 body, file list and the net diff `6390fe52..0570b5e6` against `main` (one commit, three files: +18 changeset, +6/−1 `index.ts`, +81 pin test); the check-runs on the head. Nothing was built, run or re-run; the record template was printed with `record-recognisers --template --face narrowing` as the brief asked.

### ① Derived judgments

Every accept-set / public-surface change the diff implies, named right or wrong:

1. **The entry change is exactly one runtime export leaving: `renderTemplate`. RIGHT.** The only source hunk is `index.ts:88`: `export { renderTemplate, requireVars, htmlToText } from './template-engine.js'` becomes `export { requireVars, htmlToText } from './template-engine.js'` plus a five-line `[#25190]` comment. No other export line moves; the type exports (`TemplateLoader`, `EmailTemplateRow`, …) and every other value export on the entry are byte-identical to the base.
2. **Nothing else reachable from the published surface still exposes the body-taking renderer. RIGHT.** `package.json` at the head: `exports` carries only `"."` (`dist/index.mjs` / `dist/index.js` and their `.d.ts`), `files` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; the root `tsup.config.ts` builds `entry: ['src/index.ts']` with `splitting: false`, so `dist/` holds no separate `template-engine.js` and the exports map refuses a subpath import anyway. No package re-exports `* from '@objectstack/plugin-email'`; the one re-export elsewhere (`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:6808`) names `resolveEmailCapabilityArg`, `resolveDeploymentAppName`, `EmailCapabilityArg` only. The two namespace importers in `packages/cli` (`serve-auth-app-name.contract.test.ts`, `serve-stack-email-sms-door.contract.test.ts`) read `resolveDeploymentAppName` / `resolveEmailCapabilityArg` only; `examples/app-showcase/test/email-template-locale.test.ts` imports `createRegistryEmailTemplateLoader`, `DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_LOCALE`. The function itself stays in `template-engine.ts:109` (still `export`ed from the module file, which is not a published path) and every in-package caller imports the module file, not the entry (`email-service.ts:18`, `template-engine.test.ts:4`, `text-field-html-outlets.pin.test.ts:81`).
3. **The stored-template doors keep rendering through the retired function. RIGHT.** `email-service.ts:1381` `resolveAndRenderTemplate` is untouched and still calls `renderTemplate(row.body_html, …)` at `:1465` (html face, holes encoded), `renderPlainTextTemplate` for `subject` / `body_text`, `htmlToText` for the derived text; `EmailService.renderTemplate` (`:1481`) and `sendTemplate` (`:1492`) both go through it. The pin test's third case exercises both doors with a value carrying a `b` tag and expects the html face to carry it entity-encoded (`<b>`) and the subject verbatim, which is what that code does.
4. **The narrowing matches the cited rulings' letter. RIGHT.**
   - Ruling `6335348115` item 6: retire `renderTemplate` (plugin-email) under ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired`, BREAKING, at once, no staged window. The diff does that and nothing more. `requireVars`, `htmlToText` stay on the entry as the claim `6348488271` and ruling `6349343463` item 4 fix (`setTemplateLoader`, which the card body and claim say "stays", is an `EmailService` method at `email-service.ts:638` and was never an entry export, so that line is vacuous and nothing is owed on it).
   - Ruling `6349343463` item 2: **`interpolate` stays.** At the head `packages/services/service-messaging/src/index.ts:100` still exports `interpolate`; the diff touches no file under `packages/services/`. RIGHT.
   - Ruling `6349343463` item 4 and #25293 (`6350996010`, `6356337552`): **`IEmailService.renderTemplate` stays.** The diff touches no file under `packages/spec/`; `packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts:341` still declares `renderTemplate(input: RenderTemplateInput)` returning a `Promise` of `RenderTemplateResult`, and the changeset's FROM → TO line points consumers at that very door (`services.email` `renderTemplate({ template, data, locale })` / `sendTemplate`), which is the render-by-name door the placement rule can see. RIGHT.
   - Ruling `6349343463` item 4's premise ("while the gate exits 1 the half is not written") is met on this head rather than from the record: the `Check Changeset` job, whose step "Require an ADR-0087 disposition on a declared-breaking changeset" runs `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base MERGE_BASE`, concludes **success** on `0570b5e6`, which is the three D9 predicates (retired-from-entry, no-metadata-surface with the #25349 homonym reading, from-operands-named) holding in CI.
5. **The pin test pins the narrowing both ways. RIGHT.** `'renderTemplate' in entry` is `false` (a module-namespace `in` test, the right instrument for an absent export); the control names four exports that stay; the render case goes through the service doors. The dev's reverse check (base `index.ts` restored, case 1 red) is reported; I did not re-run it and do not need to: the first case is a direct read of the entry's export list, which the diff is.
6. **Readers of the retired name. RIGHT.** My own sweep at the head: no `renderTemplate` imported from `@objectstack/plugin-email` anywhere in the tree (tests, `ui/`, `examples/`, `docs/qa/**`, `scripts/**` included); `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` at `94646738` has one `email.renderTemplate({…})` call (`test/flow-record-change.test.ts:181`), the service method, unaffected. `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx:14,224` and `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx:170` name the service method `renderTemplate({ template, data, locale })`, so no doc page is falsified. `CHANGELOG.md:1841` ("The exported `renderTemplate()` helper is still the HTML renderer") is a historical release entry, not a live claim.

Nothing in the diff is judged wrong. No accept set widens; the one accept set that narrows is the package entry's export list, by one name.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/25190-retire-render-template-export.md`: `'@objectstack/plugin-email': patch`, title `fix(plugin-email)!: …`, a `**BREAKING** (a runtime export is removed)` banner, line-initial `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` (byte-identical to the PR body's two lines), exactly one ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired @objectstack/plugin-email#renderTemplate) …`, one `FROM renderTemplate TO …` line naming the stored-template door and the one-line fix, and an "Unchanged:" line naming `IEmailService.renderTemplate`, `requireVars`, `htmlToText`, the loader.
- Repo rule (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3): the level follows the metadata-protocol kind alone — `none` takes `patch`; "a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition"; a breaking changeset carries its FROM → TO migration and exactly one ADR-0087 marker. This is also #25105 ruling A as ruling `6335348115` restates it, and the shape ruling `6349343463` item 1 fixed for PR 1 (#25285) and item 4 carried over to PR 2.
- The diff publishes exactly what the changeset says: one runtime function leaves one published entry; no key of any metadata schema, no object definition, no stored shape and no spec contract moves, so `Metadata-protocol: none` is the right kind and `patch` the right level; `(narrowing)` is the right arm (an accept set — the entry's export list — shrinks); the D9 category is the right disposition (compiler-carried break, TS2305 at the consumer's own import, no ledger entry, no tombstone). `Check Changeset` success on the head is the gate's own reading of all of this. **Level matches; `Clause-②:` line matches on both carriers. RIGHT.**

### ③ Boundary flags

PR author: **`os-project-manager`** (the attribution marker in the body; the PR is relayed through `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, per claim `6430890446` and the dev report `6431921813`, session `session_014LDnV6FyUqxjaBRSi5Kv1L`).

Check-runs on `0570b5e6` at the time of this read (per `gh api …/check-runs`): **success** — Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI/release/engine gates, the three Lint · scoped lanes, Type Check · source gates, Build Core, Test Core 7/8 and 8/8, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check Changeset (carries the ADR-0087 gate), Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check PR Size, Auto Label, Flag docs affected by code changes, Part-of PR must not also close its card, No other open PR may claim the same issue, No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path, The card this PR closes must claim this branch, filter. **in_progress (9)** — Test Core 1–6/8, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · workspace. **skipped** — the UI lanes, Temporal Conformance, Build Docs, Dogfood Verify CLI, the sharded dogfood matrix, the opt-in tarball and 18.x harnesses. No check-run reads failure. The seat reads the nine in-progress lanes again before the queue; the dev's local `tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck` exit 0 on the package is the only reading of those nine so far.

Dev flags and `open_questions`, each answered or escalated:

1. **`open_questions: []`** — none on this PR; the one fork this card ever raised (`6349141238`) was ruled by `6349343463` letter A and its premise (item 4) is met on this head by the Check Changeset gate. Answered.
2. **"npm dependants: NOT MEASURED."** Answered by the rulings, not by this review: ruling `6335348115` item 6 and ruling `6349343463` ② both carry "npm dependants unmeasured" as the known confidence gap and still rule "at once — no staged window", under the standing line 「暂时不考虑 v19，协议的调整原则上也是尽快，不考虑退役版本。」; ADR-0087 D9 names the compiler (TS2305 at the consumer's own import, with the changeset's FROM → TO line in the published CHANGELOG) as the channel that reaches every such consumer. The registry has no dependants index. Nothing further is owed on this PR; a production or npm reading, if one is ever obtained, comes back as its own card (the #25082 ruling's own disposition for unmeasured populations).
3. **Dogfood battery red (2 files, 10 tests), reported as main's red.** The dev measured the same two files red with `packages/rest/src` and `packages/qa/dogfood/test` checked out from `origin/main` `abb90460`, and the diff touches no file they read. On this head CI's `Dogfood Regression Gate` concludes **success**, so the red does not even reproduce in CI on `0570b5e6`. The out-of-scope finding (class a, carrier: whoever drives #26361 / #26291's follow-up, "noted, not filed") is not this PR's to file; escalated to the seat only as a reading — nothing is owed by this diff.
4. **Docs drift check** (`6431917025`): `index.ts` yielded no anchor, so the pages are "not covered by this run"; the coarse fallback lists 6 package-mention pages. Answered by hand in ① item 6: every live `renderTemplate` mention in `content/docs/**` is the service method. The check-run concludes success.
5. **Deviations** (branch is the harness-pinned `claude/project-thread-s91v0o`, recorded in the claim; a worker restart re-ran the full build; the PR was opened after the battery so the body is never PATCHed) — all answered by the claim and the report; no action.
6. **`Skills-docs:` line — ESCALATED to the seat.** `#26381` (`b33dd25b`, merged 2026-10-27T02:03:41Z — 56 seconds after this PR was opened at 02:02:45Z) now puts on main the rule that a PR whose `Clause-②:` carries `(narrowing)` owes the PR body a line-initial `Skills-docs: updated here | follow-up owed — FILES | follow-up #N | none — REASON` (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:313`; the seat's `review-checklist.md:18` reads "缺 ⇒ REWORK"). The body carries the substance in prose ("No `skills/**` reader"; the docs page names the service method, so it stays as written; the spec api-surface snapshots do not cover plugin-email) but not the line. The rule did not exist when the dev wrote the body, and the diff itself teaches nothing a skill or doc restates (the retired name appears in no `skills/**` file and in no live doc as an import). This is a body edit, not a code change, and does not bear on the narrowing's correctness: the seat decides whether to have the line added (`Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc imports the retired name; `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx` names the service method`) before ACCEPT. Not a contract-review FAIL.

Nothing in this review escalates to the maintainer: the retirement is the maintainer's own ruling, the sequencing was ruled under the delegation in `6349343463`, and the premise that ruling bound PR 2 to is met on this head.

   - **Changeset, sentence by sentence:**

4. **Gates:** at this stamp every check-run on the head reads success or skipped (path-filtered UI, the dogfood matrix placeholder and opt-in harnesses). None reads failed or in progress. `Check Changeset` (which runs the ADR-0087 gate), Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core 1–8 and Governed Surface Queue Guard are green. Locally the dev reports the package suite 702/702, 65 of 65 derived gates exit 0, and the full dogfood battery run because the title has a bang.

   - npm dependants are not measured. Both rulings already accept that gap under "at once, no staged window".
